1.o: A small percentage of adolescents have onsets of special abilities. Yu Otosaka deftly uses an ability that takes over a target's body for five seconds to live the school life of an honor student, and gets accepted into a prestigious high school. Just when Yu is about to live a stable life in high school, a girl named Nao Tomori appears before him...

2.o: Yu unwillingly acts together with the student council and runs amok to secure individuals with special abilities. This brings to light why Tomori is determined to fulfill student council duties in face of danger - a past involving a cruel destiny that awaited an ability wielder.

3.o: Information concerning a new ability wielder reaches Yu and the active student council members. In their search of an individual with two abilities of soul possession and pyrokinesis, Yu and company comes across a particular pop idol.

4.o: The information of an ability wielder that Kumagami relays to the student council on the day Yusa transfers into Hoshinoumi Academy points to a high school baseball pitcher that Tomori already had her eyes on. His ability is telekinesis. Against a pitcher that uses his ability to pitch what could be called diabolical balls, the Hoshinoumi Academy student council challenges him to a game of baseball to make him stop doing so.

5.t: Sound Heard Sometime In the Past
5.o: With the information from Kumagami as a hint, the student council members continue a stakeout in the middle of the mountains where a wielder of a special ability supposedly hangs out. As they spend their time barbecuing and fishing, Yu comes across the music of ZHIEND through Tomori's music player. And, the one that appeared in front of them as they continued the stakeout...

6.o: The location of the new ability wielder according to Kumagami was the condo where Ayumi was currently home with a cold. Ayumi tells Yu and Tomori who came to see how she was doing about the nightmare that she had. Tomori, thinking that the dream's details can be a hint in figuring out Ayumi's ability, tells Yu to draw out the contents of Ayumi's dream from her...

7.o: Yu, crestfallen by the fact that he lost his little sister Ayumi, shuts himself alone inside his home and cuts all communication with the outside world. Denying even the worried student council members that came to check on him, Yu leads a dissolute life only to find appearing before him...

8.o: Yu, starting to accept Ayumi's death, attends school for the first time in a while. There, he finds comfort in a school life that has not changed from before. Then, he ends up having to attend a ZHIEND live gig alone with Tomori, but on the way back home from school that day, he bumps into a foreign-looking woman carrying a white cane.

9.t: A World That Doesn't Exist Here
9.o: Yu ends up heading to a ZHIEND live gig alone with Tomori. The gigs starts and the audience heats up, but Yu feels a strange feeling within his heart...

10.o: Yu's big brother Shunsuke has the power to leap through time, but has lost his eyesight from utilizing this ability repeatedly, and is no longer able to use his power. So, now Yu must take his big brother’s place and save Ayumi.

11.o: Kumagami and Medoki appear before Yu Otosaka after he successfully rescues Ayumi. Within the laboratory facilities that they take the siblings to, Yu finds out the reason behind the outbreaks of special abilities. Kumagami then gains information regarding a new ability wielder and heads to Hoshinoumi Academy, but...

12.o: The friends from student council and Ayumi come visit Yu who is hospitalized from his injuries. Among them is Tomori. During his conversation with Tomori, Yu makes a certatin decision.

13.o:
The decision that Yu makes is to plunder the ability of every last wielder of a special ability on Earth.

It is a choice that provides salvation to every ability-wielder, but at the same time, it is a choice that makes Yu pay a huge price in return.

1.t: Umai-bou, Fries, and... / Milk Coffee Candies, Young Donuts, and...
1.o: Kokonotsu Shikada is the son of a dagashi snack shop owner. Although he wants to become a manga artist, his father, Yo, wants him to take over the family business. One day, a girl named Hotaru Shidare shows up at the shop and challenges Kokonotsu.

2.t: Kinako-bou, Namaiki Beer, and... / Fue Ramune, Menko, and...
2.o: Hotaru tells Kokonotsu that Kinako-bou grabs her attention due to its plain packaging and lack of mascot characters, calling it a desert warrior. She also gives a lecture to Kokonotsu and Saya on the history of Fue Ramune.

3.t: Buta-men, Kuru Kuru Bou Jelly, and... / Bontan-ame, Seven Neon, and...
3.o: Hotaru exacerbates the summer heat by turning off the shop's AC and boiling water to make Buta-men. Saya's suspicions are raised when Hotaru asks about her relationship with Kokonotsu.

4.t: Fugashi, Fugashi, and... / Glico, Glico, and...
4.o: Hotaru challenges Kokonotsu to compete in a blind fugashi taste test. She also helps him to run back to Café Endo when she realizes that he forgot something very important to him at the café.

5.t: Bottle Ramune, Baby-Star Ramen, and... / Yatta Men, Watch Out for the Sour Grape, and...
5.o: Hotaru visits Shikada Dagashi after business hours to conduct a covert exchange with Kokonotsu’s father Yo. Later, she lets Kokonotsu and To in on her secret moneymaking technique.

6.t: Super Himo Q, Ohajiki, and sometimes Maken Gumi... / Yoguret, Coconuts, and...
6.o: Kokonotsu, To, and Saya visit the temple, where they find Hotaru behaving even more strangely than usual. On a separate occasion, Saya reminisces about playing with Kokonotsu when they were in the third grade.

7.t: Summer Festival, Hotaru, and... / Summer Festival, Saya, and...
7.o: It’s summer festival time! Hotaru plans to convert her meager 200 yen of spending money into big winnings at the die-cutting stall. Later on, Saya is very happy when Yo suggests that Kokonotsu escort her around the festival.

8.t: Super Scary Story Gum, Typhoon, and... / Kendama, Popping Fortune-Telling Chocolate, and...
8.o: Kokonotsu and the gang are cooped up in Shikada Dagashi due to a typhoon. So To starts telling scary stories to liven things up. On a separate occasion, To tells Kokonotsu that he’s been researching how to become popular among girls.

9.t: Wata-pachi, Lucky Choco-droppings, and... / Sakura Daikon, Egg Ice Cream, and...
9.o: Despite suffering from a mouth ulcer, Hotaru ignores Saya's protestations and eats a dagashi that packs a punch. Later on, Hotaru lets Kokonotsu in on the secret of her origins.

10.o: When Hotaru doesn't show up at Shikada Dagashi for two days, a concerned Kokonotsu and Saya visit her house to investigate. It appears Hotaru has come down with a cold so powerful that she doesn’t even want to eat dagashi.

11.t: Cola Gum, Yo, and... / Miyako Kombu, Ramune, and...
11.o: When Kokonotsu asks why Shidare Company wants to recruit his dad, Hotaru tries to show him and Saya how amazing Yo is. On a separate occasion, Kokonotsu and Hotaru discuss dagashi while waiting for a train.

12.t: I’m Gonna Eat It-Hi, Poem of Cherries, and... / Morinaga Milk Caramel, Sakuma Drops, and...
12.o: While Hotaru and Saya discuss matters of love, Kokonotsu and To seek once again to improve their fortunes through dagashi. Another day, Kokonotsu tries to use his knowledge of dagashi to impress an expectant Hotaru.

1.o: When Kokonotsu whispers a certain word, it summons Hotaru. On a different occasion, Hotaru suddenly shows up at Café Endo to satisfy Saya's wish.

2.t: Baseball Board Game Gum, Pop Pop Boat, and...
2.o: On the day a typhoon is approaching, Saya, To, and Hotaru gather at Kokonotsu's house. As the wind and rain get stronger, Kokonotsu suggests that they spend the night there.

3.o: While Kokonotsu and To are trying to figure out how to play with beigoma, Hotaru shows up with her beigoma to battle with them.

4.o: Kokonotsu and the gang decide to go to the fireworks festival. When Saya asks him to call Hotaru, he finds her at the shop choosing a Homerun Bar with a very serious face.

5.t: Ambulance, Get a Move On, You Cod! and...
5.o: Ever since Hotaru stopped coming to Shikada Dagashi, Kokonotsu has been feeling down. On top of that, Yo tells him that the shop is in financial trouble.

6.o: Kokonotsu, To and Saya go check out the new convenience store. There, they meet the store’s manager, who begins to see Kokonotsu as his rival.

7.o: A woman walks into Shikada Dagashi after seeing the help-wanted flyer that Kokonotsu put out on the shop's door and asks him to hire her.

8.t: Roll Candy, High Eight Chocolate, and...
8.o: After coming across a woman seeing off Kokonotsu in the morning in front of his shop, Saya cannot stop thinking about it all day long and decides to check out this woman.

9.o: After talking to the convenience store manager, Kokonotsu decides to create a website for Shikada Dagashi. On a different occasion, Hajime tries to cover up the fact that she forgot to order a product.

10.o: After setting up the shop's website, Shikada Dagashi receives its first delivery order. Later on, Kokonotsu decides to bring his manga to an on-site manga review event.

11.t: Homerun Bar Winning Stick, Snow, and...
11.o: With the help from Hajime, Saya, and To, Kokonotsu completes his manga in time and brings it to the On-site Manga Review Event.

12.o: After a surprise reunion with Hotaru at a train station, Kokonotsu asks her why she suddenly disappeared without saying anything to him.

1.o: The band is put together and commits itself to constant change.

2.o: The Grateful Dead sabotage their chances at superstardom, and find success on their own terms.

3.t: Let's Go Get In The Band
3.o: It's not clear where the fans end and the band begins.

4.o: Jerry wants the Grateful Dead to have no leader, no rules... and no purpose. Trouble ensues.

5.o: It's the 1980s, and the Dead's fans seek adventure in this “New Lame America” as Garcia calls it.

6.o: Jerry will put up with the adulation until they “come for me with the cross and nails.”

1.o: Seth, a young boy living in the peaceful Pompo Hills, trains daily to become a great wizard and go hunting for the Nemesis, the monsters that terrorize humanity. He does not know it yet, but the adventure is about to ring at his door.

2.o: Following the fall of a Nemesis egg on the Pompo Hills, Seth decides to protect the villagers in the absence of Alma. While the creature is about to defeat him, the young wizard is saved by a strange foursome ...

3.o: Alma is convinced that normal humans and wizards will never be able to understand each other. After repeating it again to Seth, she remembers their meeting ...

4.o: Seth left the Alma Observatory to search for the Radiant. On the way to Artemis, the city of witches, he is captured by a patrol of inquisitors.

5.t: A Paradise of Wisdom and Hope -Artemis-
5.o: Seth arrived at the Artemis Institute, the city of sorcerers. He must find the Yaga wizard to get information about the Radiant, but a yellow cat might make it difficult for him...

6.o: Artemis was released from an Inquisition strike by Master Lord Majesty. Seth hurried to prove to the heir to the sorcerer Yaga affine that heaven accepts you as a disciple.

7.o: On a quiet afternoon, Doc is taken to the sewers of the Artemis Institute by a mysterious creature. With Melie's help, Seth goes to the depths of the city to save his friend.

8.o: As part of his training with the sorcerer Yaga, Seth finds himself banned from using magic. That's when the Bravery Quartet decides to attack Artemis! Deprived of his powers, can Seth protect the city?

9.o: The days are similar and similar to Captain Dragunov and his crew, stationed in a peaceful area. However, a distress call sent by another crew of inquisitors will change this monotonous daily.

10.o: Master Lord Majesty organizes a festival within Artemis, and the party is in full swing. Seth then meets Nick, a young wizard who is slandering Alma. To defend the honor of his adoptive mother, Seth will have to beat him at the broomsticks race of the festival!

11.t: The City That Roars Like Thunder -Rumble Town-
11.o: In order to settle their debts, Seth and his friends agree to investigate a series of disappearances caused by a nemesis in the town of Rumble Town. Caution should be used, because the nemesis may not be the only dangers in the shadows of alleys ...

12.t: The Shadow Lurking in the City -Darkness-
12.o: After escaping the wizard Grimm, Seth and his friends visit the Zehd family, who asked them to investigate the nemesis raging in Rumble Town. The hunt for nemesis continues in the alleys of the industrial city!

13.o: Bringing the responsibility of recent events to wizards and immigrants, Captain Konrad heats the people of his city to white and encourages him to hunt them down. That said, it seems that the reality is quite different, and one begins to wonder if Konrad does not hide a terrible secret ...

14.t: The Bell Tolls the Sound of Destruction -Catastrophe-
14.o: Grimm's latest attack defeated Doc's courage in announcing his intention to withdraw from Rumble Town's nemesis investigation. Meanwhile, the inquisitor Konrad de Marburg assembles the citizens against the wizards and immigrants of the city.

15.o: The inquisitor Captain Konrad de Marburg is defeated, but Rumble Town is still threatened by the witch Hameline, blinded by vengeance. More than ever, the survival of the city rests on the shoulders of Seth and his companions.

16.t: Fly High and Pierce Through the Storm -Rising-
16.o: To prevent Hameline from destroying the islet of Rumble Town, Seth and his friends will have to cooperate with Grimm, the mysterious character covered with bandages ...

17.t: To Stop the Sound of the Wind -Serenade-
17.o: The hour of the confrontation between Hameline and Seth rang! Will the young wizard succeed in convincing his opponent to renounce revenge before it is too late?

18.t: The Light That Follows the Darkness -Awakening-
18.o: Thaumaturgians arrive at Rumble Town to capture Seth! After seeing General Torque defeat Hameline, Seth loses control of himself and unleashes his destructive power ...

19.o: Rumble Town is saved, and all Sorcerers of Artemis consider Seth a real hero. However, the latter does not forgive himself for not having been able to save Hameline...

20.o: Following the Rumble Town incident, the Inquisition tries to regain the trust of the people. Meanwhile, Seth and his friends are suffering from the shortage of coffee beans at Artemis...

21.o: To continue his search for the Radiant, Yaga advises Seth to visit Caislean Merlin, the capital of Cyfandir. But suddenly, Artemis is attacked by a real army of nemesis.

1.o: Seth returns with Alma before leaving for the city of Caislean Merlin, capital of the sorcerer knights to find the answers he needs. Meanwhile, Captain Dragunov is sent to a secluded place in what he believes is a punishment for his actions, but ...

2.o: Seth sets out for the capital but gets intercepted by a Merchant-Baron airship. Seth barely escapes thanks to Grimm, and successfully reaches the capital where he encounters Doc and Melie.

3.o: After attempting to enter the castle's archives, Seth gets kicked out! Seth is later introduced to Ocoho and joins her in battle.

4.o: Seth and Ocoho face off against a powerful Spectral Nemesis band while attempting to protect a small farm from destruction.

5.o: Seth tracks down Melie and Doc at the Luchorpan Inn, and attempts to make amends with them.

6.o: Guided by a reocurring dream, Seth attempts to sneak into the archives at Caislean Merlin. Here, he learns a dark truth about the origins of the Spectral Nemesis.

7.o: Seth hangs on for dear life as he attempts to escape the Diabal’s grasp. Meanwhile, Grimm is badly wounded in an altercation.

8.t: Seth in the Forest of Time -Caillte-
8.o: Seriously wounded after his clash with Diabal, Seth is collected by Myr. Meanwhile, Melie, Ocoho and Doc set off in search of the young wizard. Their research leads them to the forest of Caillte, a mysterious place from which nobody returns...

9.o: In order to master the power within him, Seth decides to stay in the Caillte forest to train with Myr. Meanwhile, Melie and Ocoho are summoned by Queen Boadicea for disobeying orders during the battle against the spectrums.

10.o: As Seth continues his training with Myr, the Witch-Knights face a nemesis threatening the people of Cyfandir. Despite the presence of the gallant Lord Gulis, defeating the monster could be a harder task than it seems ...

11.o: After rescuing villagers from a nemesis, Ocoho and Melie return to Caislean Merlin. Meanwhile, Seth completes his training with Myr and learns more about the mysterious old man...

12.t: The Truth Is Like a Curse -Ocoho-
12.o: Peace has reigned in Caislean Merlin for some time. However, Lord Brangoire behaves suspiciously and seems to be watching Ocoho and his friends closely.

13.o: Liselotte and Dragunov meet Baron Doussant, who tells them of his terrible intentions. Ocoho, meanwhile, leaves to ask Mordred for an explanation about his condition after each of their meetings.

14.o: The Inquisition begins the invasion. Queen Boudica swears to resist until the end. Meanwhile, Seth infiltrates the castle and questions Diabal about his origins. Then listen to Piodon's secret. Who are these men? And who is Seth?

15.t: Led to the Abyss by a Melody of Death -Harmonizium-
15.o: The war between Cyfandir and the Inquisition is raging, and the anti-Fantasia device pushes the Knights-Wizards to their last entrenchments. In the basement of Caislean Merlin's castle, Seth tries to convince Diabal to join him.

16.t: The Light of Life is Extinguished -Tragedy-
16.o: On the Barons-Merchant ship, Baron Doussant reveals to Ocoho his objective behind the Cyfandir invasion. On the ground, Lord Brangoire and Queen Boadicea struggled as best they could against the Thaumaturges and the troops of the Inquisition.

17.o: Queen Boadicea was captured by the Inquisition, and the plight of the Sorcerer Sorcerers appears hopeless. Meanwhile, Seth and Mélie are struggling with the miracle workers Dragunov and Liselotte.

18.t: The Will of the People Shines Bright -Resistance-
18.o: Doc bursts into battle in mysterious armor and faces Verona, the young Thaumaturge. Meanwhile, Seth fights mercilessly against Colonel Santori.

19.o: Seth defeated Thaumaturge Santori in a fierce battle, and Ocoho finally cornered Baron-Marchand Doussant on his own ship. Cyfandir seems to be on the verge of winning the war, but that is without counting on the plan of the inquisitive commander Ullmina ...

20.t: A Bouquet of Flowers for This Land -Fantasia-
20.o: Devastated by Jill's death, Myr is determined to eradicate humanity in Cyfandir. Seth also gives up on the rage, as affected by the despair of the forest elf. Can Melia, Ocoho, Doc and Dragunov manage to soothe these two forces of nature?

21.o: The kingdom of Cyfandir emerged victorious from its war against the Inquisition, but not unscathed. However, the appointment of a new sovereign may well bring hope to this battered land.

1.o: Public schoolboy JP, insecure Kingsley, wide-eyed Josie, socially awkward know-it-all Howard, hard-living Vod and desperate-to-be-cool Oregon embark on the most exciting period of their lives so far.

2.o: The housemates are in social Siberia so they decide to throw a party, spearheaded by Josie in the hope that she and Kingsley will get together, but her plans are scuppered by her boyfriend!

3.o: Oregon and Prof Shales's flirtation reaches bizarre new levels when he pays her to clean his oven. And enticed by Ruth the alluring drama queen, Kingsley rashly switches courses to drama.

4.o: Kingsley is forced to confess to Josie that he is a virgin, and she offers to 'cure' him. But the deal is undercut when Kingsley unexpectedly winds up having sex with drama queen Ruth.

5.o: Vod finds out about Oregon's affair with Shales, while Kingsley is pursuing Ruth at a student demo when they get kettled with Josie, and Kingsley's two-timing is exposed.

6.o: Oregon is distraught to learn that her childhood horse is dying, culminating in the revelation that she isn't called Oregon at all, but Melissa.

7.o: Oregon resolves to break off her affair with Professor Shales, but he wrong-foots her by leaving his wife and turning up on her doorstep. Brian begs Howard to resume their friendship.

8.o: Josie embarks on a 'girl power' booze and sex fest with help from Vod. JP helps Ralph organise the Love Cloud club night but it clashes with his dad's funeral.

1.o: It's a new term. Kingsley has a new image. Josie turns over a new leaf. JP's friend Giles has transferred from Exeter. Vod's skint and it's time to find a replacement for invisible flatmate Paul Lamb.

2.o: A spate of muggings on campus leave the gang concerned about their safety, while JP is confined to his bed with mumps. Kingsley makes an announcement that leaves Josie reeling.

3.o: A geology careers fair sets the boys against each other as they battle for lucrative internships. Oregon is thrown together with Tony again, as she attempts to secure funding for her new magazine.

4.o: It's the Easter break and JP invites the gang to stay at his country house, but it's not as idyllic as it seems...

5.o: Things go from bad to worse when Josie makes a catastrophic error of judgement. A chance encounter leads Oregon to fall for a sexy librarian, JP makes a 'local' friend, Vod falls in love and Howard turns detective in a bid to catch an intruder.

6.o: Spurred on by a righteous sense of getting-his-money's-worth, Kingsley makes an official complaint, but when a field trip goes awry, things come to a head for him and JP.

7.o: At an open mic gig at the Student Union, Kingsley performs a song written by Blur's Graham Coxon. And Vod gatecrashes a poetry seminar by the renowned poet John Frobisher.

8.o: The end of the academic year is coming close and with it is the need for the housemates to make some huge decisions. Josie has to decide what to do with her life. Kingsley finds himself moving in to a one-bedroom flat with Heather, before some old feelings re-emerge just when he least expects them. Sabine manages to blow Howard's mind with her news. Oregon's relationship with Dylan comes to a head at Jean Shales' book launch.

1.o: Howard and JP try to coax some female freshers to join their dry-slope skiing society, while Vod's summer fling turns up unexpectedly. And the gang go to visit Josie in Southampton where she's now studying. But her traffic-light party creates a few problems for Kingsley.

2.o: Vod comes up with a plan to get rid of her holiday romance. Howard likes a girl but JP thinks she's out of his league, so he tries to poach her in order to restore the natural order of things.

3.o: Realising how serious Javier has become since their wedding, Vod tries to dump him, but it's not that simple...

4.o: Having been rejected by Sam for cheating in the quiz, JP makes it his mission to win her back.

5.o: Vod announces that her mum is coming to stay and, when she arrives, she is not what anybody expected.

6.o: The housemates get radical as they participate in a university sit-in which Oregon has organized to demonstrate against the forced deportation of a hot Tunisian guy.

7.o: Word gets out that it's Howard's birthday, and Candice insists they throw him a party. Unfortunately, not everyone sees the gathering in quite the same terms.

8.o: Following last week's party some relationships and friendships are on the rocks. Oregon battles it out against Vod in the Student Union elections. Josie and Kingsley reach an unusual arrangement to overcome their relationship issues. Howard realises that it's now or never with Candice.

1.o: The housemates are nearing the end of their university lives, but before they face some hard-core studying, JP plans one last big blowout.

2.o: Vod gets a job in a pub, and the others expect her to give them free drinks. Oregon creates a poetry prize in her own honour, and Kingsley discovers Rosa has an 18-year-old son.

3.o: It's dissertation time, and while Vod is having a last-minute wobble about her abilities, Oregon has other 'presidency' things on her mind and Josie is having an identity crisis.

4.o: Oregon's glittering future looks seriously under threat, and things aren't going well for Josie either. Howard is working on his CV, and Kingsley and Vod take over the grad ball.

5.o: The finals are fast approaching and things are falling apart.Tickets for the alternative grad ball Vodstock are selling well, but Vod may be promising things she can't deliver.

6.o: The finals are over and the results are in, but not everyone's happy. Will the housemates host the best grad ball of all time or will they have to flee Manchester in the night?

1.o: A soldier from 1569, a female college student from 1880 and a modern-day paramedic must prevent two Frenchmen in 1808 from altering a war's outcome.

2.o: The patrol travels to Lisbon in 1588 to stop Lope de Vega from dying before he writes his greatest works.

3.o: The Ministry sends agents to 1940 after a man being chased by Nazis promises to show Heinrich Himmler how to travel in time if he'll spare his life.

4.o: Ordered to pay millions for the death of the rabbi who wrote the Book of Doors, the Ministry sends the trio to 1491 to prevent his execution for heresy.

5.t: Any Time in the Past Was Better
5.o: The patrol must go to 1981 Madrid to find a copy of a missing bill of sale for Picasso's "Guernica" to ensure the masterpiece is returned to Spain.

6.o: The patrol meets the novella-inspiring Lazarillo de Tormes while visiting 1520 Salamanca to capture a fugitive hiding from the law via time travel.

7.o: The patrol travels to 1844 to stop the assassination of Isabel II at the hands of a Ministry rebel, and the disappearance of the Ministry altogether.

8.o: When the Ministry learns a young Salvador Dalí has designed a film poster in 1924 featuring a tablet computer, the patrol is sent to investigate.

1.o: The Ministry travels to the 11th century to solve a mystery involving the burial remains of El Cid. Julián faces the consequences of his actions.

2.o: Pacino, a police officer who's been missing since 1981, reappears in the present and finds out he's now a suspect in the crime he was investigating.

3.o: Pacino joins the team for the first time as they work to ensure that Miguel de Cervantes publishes "Don Quixote" in 1604.

4.o: Spain's transition from a dictatorship to a democracy is in jeopardy when the life of a crucial Spanish politician's ancestor is threatened.

5.o: Irene contracts the Spanish flu while on a mission in 1918. Susana insists she be brought back to the present, putting the entire Ministry at risk.

6.o: The team travels to 1920s New York, into the world of magic and Houdini, as the Ministry's own existence is placed in peril.

7.o: While hiding out in the Philippines in the 19th century, Julián makes a promise to a dying soldier that gets him into a dangerous situation.

8.o: Salvador sends Alonso on a mission to save Julián from a lengthy battle during the Siege of Baler in the Philippines.

9.o: A Velázquez painting is auctioned off in 2016. The only problem is it burned in a 1734 fire. The team heads to the Alcázar of Madrid to investigate.

10.o: Irene looks into a mystery involving a group of avant-garde women artists who've been forgotten. The Ministry discovers the Vampire of Raval is free.

11.o: On a tour of the Ministry, redesigned to look like a regular office, a suspicious paranormal expert barges past a barrier and through one of the doors.

12.o: Ortigosa and Natalia's wedding is complicated by a hidden time portal and a romantic legend from the 13th century.

13.o: Phillip II of Spain decides he wants the Spanish Armada to win in 1588. He gets a taste for time travel and sets his sights higher, focusing on 2016.

1.o: Mourning a loss, the patrol is sent to foil a plan to kidnap Alfred Hitchcock during the premiere of "Vertigo" at the 1958 San Sebastián Film Festival.

2.o: A Spanish spy's capture in Nazi-occupied France in 1943 jeopardizes Britain's Operation Mincemeat, critical to the Allied victory of World War II.

3.o: When Gustavo Adolfo Bécquer writes one too many "Letters from My Cell," the patrol travels to 1864 Trasmoz, where a woman is accused of witchcraft.

4.o: In the present-day Prado Museum, an invisible force slashes Goya's "Nude Maja," sending the Ministry to 1799 to convince the artist to repaint it.

5.o: The trio travels to 1605 Valladolid after the attempted poisoning of a British envoy threatens the signing of a peace treaty between Spain and England.

6.o: An 1881 assassination attempt on Alfonso XII pulls the agents into Spain's slave-trading past, forcing one to choose between family and the Ministry.

7.o: When Luis Buñuel's "Viridiana" fails to pass Francoist censorship, Irene travels to 1961 with Pacino and Alonso to ensure the film wins at Cannes.

8.o: The disappearance of a Spanish priest key to Hernán Cortés's conquest of Mexico sends Alonso and Pacino to the 16th-century Yucatán Peninsula.

9.o: To find a portal to the future, the Exterminating Angel abducts Abraham Levi, who escapes to 1417 Peñíscola and begs Antipope Benedict XIII for help.

10.o: Moorish refugees from 1609 inundate the Ministry headquarters. Alonso and Pacino must stop an assassination plot against Simón Bolívar in 1828 Bogotá.

11.o: A cancellation of the premiere of "La Verbena de la Paloma" sends three Ministry workers to 1894. Alonso interrogates Arteche, who tells his life story.

12.o: The patrol is dispatched to 1976 after learning that Adolfo Suárez is not among the candidates for prime minister of Spain.

13.o: The 1966 debut of a TV series about the Ministry of Time threatens to prevent Chicho Ibáñez Serrador's "Historias para no dormir" from ever premiering.

1.o: Between the first two rounds of the French presidential election, Mayor of Dunkirk Philippe Rickwaert, the friend and personal advisor to the Socialist candidate Francis Laugier, is warned there will be a financial investigation in a social housing office in Dunkirk which he misused to finance the campaign.

2.o: While the elections take place, Rickwaert figures out Laugier's new strategy - he has sent his special advisor, Dorendeu, to help a Green candidate to hinder the far-right candidate's chances of retaining its Northern constituency.

3.o: Having become increasingly ill, the first secretary of the Socialist Party steps down, triggering a vicious battle over succession to the post. As conflict ensues between Rickwaert and Laugier, Dorendeu finds herself caught in the middle of it all.

4.o: While Laugier launches education reforms, Rickwaert decides he can use a student movement against him. In Rickwaert's opinion, pulling the strings behind a demonstration for young people will pave the perfect path for him to return to the heart of politics.

2.o: ما بين يخت يرسو قبالة "يابسة" وجناح في "باريس" خلال أسبوع الموضة، يتّضح نمط حياة "آنا" المبهر حين يزوّد أصدقاؤها القدامى "فيفيان" بالتفاصيل.

5.o: تخلّ زلّة قديمة بتوازن "فيفيان" فيما تتقصّى حول إقامة "آنا" في فندق فاخر تعرّفت فيه على موظفة استقبال الفندق "نيف"، ومنحتها إكرامية باذخة.

6.o: تستلم "فيفيان" فيديو من رحلة "آنا" المشؤومة إلى "المغرب"، ضمن إجازة باهظة مع "رايتشيل" و"كيسي" ومصوّر فيديو، والتي سرعان ما انقلبت إلى فوضى.

7.o: تقع "فيفيان" تحت الضغط لإنهاء مقالها عن "آنا"، ومع اقتراب موعد ولادة طفلتها، تحاول التواصل مع "رايتشيل" لسماع روايتها عن مشكلتها في "مراكش".

8.o: تنبش "فيفيان" في أسئلة معلّقة بعد نشر مقالها، منها ما يتعلق بسنين نشأة "آنا" في ألمانيا ومكوثها في فندق "شاتو مارمونت" في "لوس أنجلوس".

9.o: تصبح "آنا" مهووسة بمظهرها في المحاكمة فيما تغطّي "فيفيان" أخبار ما يحدث، وتدلي "رايتشيل" بشهادتها ويناشد محامي الدفاع "تود" موكلته بالتعاون.

8.o: تكشف "يسرى" و"سمير" عن فكرتهما التجارية لـ"مو" ويدعوانه للانضمام إليهما، ويبرم "مو" لاحقًا صفقة مع "بادي" تقوده إلى مكان مجهول.

1.o: يجدُ "مو" نفسه عالقًا في مدينة "مكسيكو سيتي" ويعمل في وظائف متفرقة، ومع اقتراب موعد جلسة استماع طلب اللجوء لعائلته في "هيوستن"، تتضاءل أمامه خيارات العودة.

2.o: تتلقى "يسرى" و"سمير" خبرًا سعيدًا طال انتظاره، ويحاول "مو" التواصل مجددًا مع أحبائه بعد معاناة طويلة على الحدود، لكنه يكتشف أنه قد أصبح خارج دائرة حياتهم.

3.ar: نعم أيها الطاهي، كلا أيها الطاهي
3.o: مع معاناته من حسرة الفراق، يعود "مو" إلى روتينه المُرهق ويتلقّى نصيحة لم يطلبها. وفي حفلة انتقال "نيك" و"تويا" إلى المنزل الجديد، تتجدد ذكريات الماضي وتشتعل شرارات جديدة.

4.o: يواجه "مو" صراعًا مع وضعه القانوني كمهاجر ومشاعره تجاه "ماريا"، بينما يحتدم الخلاف بينه وبين "سمير" حول إدارة أعمال العائلة.

5.o: مع تطلّع "مو" لحياة أكثر خصوصية واستقلالية، ينتقل للعيش مع "حميد" و"دالاس" اللذين يخبئان له خططًا مغايرة. فيما تشتد الخلافات بين "يسرى" و"نادية" حول ما يعتبرانه الأفضل لصحة "سمير".

6.o: يعود "مو" إلى نقطة البداية بعد أن تمكّن من تجاوز سوء الفهم، وبينما تشكل أخبار "بادي" صدمة قاسية، تبدي عائلة "النجار" إصرارًا على مواجهة التحديات وإنقاذ أعمالها.

7.o: بدافع الندم، ينطلق "مو" لتصحيح الأمور بعد شجار يكلّفه الكثير، فيما تستقبل عائلة "النجار" ضيفًا غير متوقع أثناء تناولها عشاء "عيد الشكر".

8.o: بعد مضي عام، تنطلق عائلة "النجار" في رحلة طال انتظارها إلى الوطن. وعلى بُعد خطوات معدودة، يتجلى أمام "مو" حلمه الذي طالما راوده، وقد بات حقيقة.

2.o: يتآمر نيكولاس مع كبار الوزراء بسبب قلقه بشأن تأثير زوباك الكبير على إيلينا، ويأمل أن يكشف عن معلومات خطيرة.

4.o: تحاول إيلينا تقليل حجم الأضرار من خلال إعادة التواصل مع شعبها. وفي هذه الأثناء، يتم اختبار ولاء أغنيس من خلال عرض من مجهول.

5.o: وسط تصاعد العنف، تبقى إيلينا مصممة على البقاء في القصر، بينما يخطط مستشاروها للإطاحة بها من السلطة.

1.o: بعد التحاقها بمدرسة القديس "دومينيك" التحضيرية، تتفحص"يوميكو" الطالبة الجديدة القوانين وتحدد حجم المنافسة وتضع تَصدّر القائمة نصب عينيها.

2.o: يزيد "سوكي" من حدة المنافسة ويتحدى "يوميكو" في لعبة مخيفة مصمّمة لكشف أحلك أسرار اللاعبين، في حين تتأقلم "ماري" مع حياتها كحيوان أليف.

3.o: تشتعل الشائعات في المدرسة بعد تلقي خبر مأساوي، وتنطلق رهانات جانبية غير رسمية، فيما ترقص "يوميكو" على أنغام الخطر. أما "كيرا"، فتقاتل للحفاظ على تفوّقها.

4.o: يضع أحدهم رهانًا جريئًا في عيد ميلاد "راين" فهل سيفقد عذريته قبل منتصف الليل؟ وفي تلك الأثناء، تنْصب "يوميكو" فخًا مميتًا، وتبحث "ريري" عن الخائن.

5.o: "الديناري" و"السباتي" و"الكوبة" و"البستوني"، تضع مباراة ضارية بين المنازل للاستيلاء على الأعلام كلًا من "مايكل و"يوميكو" في مواجهة بعضهما بعضًا.

6.o: إنها ليلة مليئة بالمفاجآت والاكتشافات الصادمة، في حفل رقص فاخر للملوك والملكات حيث يتوّج فيها ملك واحد على العرش.

7.o: تخاطر "يوميكو" اليائسة بكل شيء للمنافسة في صيد "الحيوانات الأليفة" في جو مشحون بالعداء. في حين، ينطلق "مايكل" في مهمة مسلحًا بالخريطة.

8.o: مع ضيق الوقت لدخول قائمة العشرة الأوائل قبل نهاية الفصل، تكشف "يوميكو" سرّ القديس "دومينيك" والذي من شأنه تغيير قواعد اللعبة.

9.o: تقترب "يوميكو" من تذوق طعم الانتقام في منتجع مجلس إدارة المدرسة، فهل يستطيع "راين" و"مايكل" إيقافها قبل ارتكاب خطأ فادح؟

10.o: كل ثانية تصنع فارقًا أثناء خوض "يوميكو" و"كيرا" أصعب مواجهة في تاريخهما أمام بعضهما بعضًا، في ظل عواقب أخطر مما يمكن تصوّره!

1.o: Stanley Tucci feasts on pizza in Naples. Stanley embarks on a whirlwind tour to find the freshest mozzarella and the best San Marzano tomatoes, and enjoys a spectacular spaghetti and zucchini.

4.o: Stanley Tucci eats and drinks his way around Milan. Here, Stanley enjoys an aperitivo, feels inspired to make pizzoccheri – a noodle made from buckwheat, and enjoys classic Milanese – veal chops and risotto.

6.o: Stanley Tucci visits Sicily. Here, Stanley tries a salty crunchy sensation, tastes the grapes grown in the region’s unique soils, and reflects on Sicilian hospitality.

2.o: Stanley visits the region that made the dream of unified Italy a reality. Piedmont boasts refined French heritage and precious peasant traditions. Once the engine room of Italian industrialization, Piedmont is now spearheading a slow food revolution. Between reimagined risotto and the elusive white truffle, Stanley discovers a region with an illustrious past but with its sights firmly set on the future.

3.o: While this small, predominantly rural region lives in the shadow of its more glamourous neighbor, Tuscany, Umbria has an ancient history that predates even the Romans. From wild boar hunts to incredible black truffle farms, Stanley explores the riches this land has to offer, while also questioning whether old traditions and centuries of religious orthodoxy are preventing younger generations from breaking through.

4.o: Stanley sets out to explore how Italian immigration has transformed the food scene in his adopted hometown of London. Forget what you think you know about this city. London is a culinary mecca where Italian food from every region gets a chance to shine. The burrata is so creamy and pasta is so fresh that it may rival Italy itself.  For over a century, Italians here have found inventive ways to create Italian food so good it’s enough to render Stanley speechless.

5.o: In this episode, Stanley Tucci travels through the Calabria region, discovering the history of this beautiful and troubled place, as well as the history of his own family. Joined by his parents and reunited with Italian relatives, he reflects on the inspiration people draw from Calabria, and why those who leave this region feel compelled to return.

6.o: In this episode, Stanley Tucci visits the Italian island of Sardinia. He experiences the culinary delights of its coastal cities influenced by previous civilizations, and ventures inland to discover the rural heart of Sardinia, which remains untouched from outsider influence.
